headline: Brazil beat India 4-0 in historic first-ever international friendly
summary: The five-time world champions dominated the match at Kolkata's Yuva Bharati Stadium, with Lino scoring twice.
details: Brazil secured a dominant 4-0 victory over India in their first-ever international friendly match, held at the Yuva Bharati Stadium in Kolkata.
Lino was the star of the match, scoring two goals to lead the Brazilian side to a comfortable win.
Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti made seven changes to the starting XI that faced Australia, giving opportunities to several new players.
Key players like Gabriel Magalhaes and Bruno Guimaraes were left out, while Marquinhos, Matheusinho and Douglas Santos returned to the starting lineup.
Vinicius Junior retained his place in the attack, and Pedro was brought into the XI.
For India, captain Gurpreet Singh Sandhu made his 90th international appearance as goalkeeper.
The Indian attack was led by Manvir Singh, Ryan Williams, and Ashique Kuruniyan.
caption:
Brazil 4, India 0. The five-time world champions make their historic first-ever meeting on Indian soil.

Brazil secured a dominant 4-0 victory over India in their first-ever international friendly match, held at the Yuva Bharati Stadium in Kolkata.

Lino was the star of the match, scoring two goals to lead the Brazilian side to a comfortable win.

Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti made seven changes to the starting XI that faced Australia, giving opportunities to several new players.

Key players like Gabriel Magalhaes and Bruno Guimaraes were left out, while Marquinhos, Matheusinho and Douglas Santos returned to the starting lineup.

Vinicius Junior retained his place in the attack, and Pedro was brought into the XI.

For India, captain Gurpreet Singh Sandhu made his 90th international appearance as goalkeeper.

The Indian attack was led by Manvir Singh, Ryan Williams, and Ashique Kuruniyan.

headline: 3 motorcyclists killed in Bagerhat road crash, 6 injured
summary: A three-way collision between two motorcycles and a Nosimon involving multiple casualties occurred on the Signboard-Bogi regional highway.
details: Three motorcyclists were killed and six others injured in a three-way collision between two motorcycles and a Nosimon in Morelganj, Bagerhat.
The accident occurred around 7 PM on Saturday (September 3) in front of the Dona government primary school on the Signboard-Bogi regional highway.

The deceased have been identified as Limon Molla (24), son of Babul Molla from Kalikabari; Md. Amin Khan (23), son of Nazrul Islam from Dona village; and Shoheb (16), son of Jamal Master from the same village.

According to acting Upazila Health Officer Dr. Md. Sifat Khan, four of the injured were discharged after receiving treatment, while two others in critical condition were sent to Khulna Medical College Hospital.
Morelganj Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Shahidul Islam stated that the families of the deceased have been notified and the bodies will be handed over after legal formalities.
